findings.text: the node's named gate required every tests file asserting on recovery.py, but the target manifest and this paragraph record that the all-file cohort never completed and test_crew.py timed out without a summary, so the review has no complete zero-added-failures receipt for the required aperture.

the evidence page relies on a head-local style block that reckon audit-doc reports the SPA drops, so the recout and measures presentation is not the presentation readers receive through the canonical plan surface.

the comment describes the tuple as facts "this node makes reachable" instead of naming the carriage mechanism, leaving transient task context in source despite the repository rule that comments stand alone without plan or worker context.

the documentation commit subject embeds the plan slug and its body names Section 3, violating the repository's unconditional ban on plan references in commit messages even though the committed file scope is correct.

justifications.durability: tests/test_wait_facts_reach_the_event.py:98-180 binds both propagation boundaries, the explicit unmeasured None state, and distinct sentinels that catch missing, swapped, or coerced fields.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_wait_facts_reach_the_event.py:98-180 passes 3/3 independently and the recorded base receipt fails the same 3/3, but docs/evidence/archive/monitor-renders-what-it-is-given-landed.html:145-148 records that the required all-file recovery cohort never completed.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery.py:2422-2433 and :2668-2679 follow the surrounding field-by-field snapshot and event idiom, but the evidence page uses SPA-dropped local CSS and the test comment and documentation commit retain task-context naming forbidden by repository policy.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:2428-2433 and :2675-2679 carry all five requested wait facts from the classified row through the snapshot into the transition event without changing the renderer.
justifications.scope_discipline: commits 545aecb1 and 35c6baab change exactly the four declared paths and the target worktree is clean.
